Name: Sherah
Summary: Daughter of Ephraim who built Beth-horon the nether and the upper, and Uzzen-sherah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:24: Daughter of Ephraim who built Beth-horon the nether and the upper, and Uzzen-sherah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Sherah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
